meta.name: [START-601] It seems that Rui-chan from Miss A University got a job offer as a female announcer through her pillow talk.
meta.description: JAV Guru has somehow turned what used to be an entertaining site into an absolute wasteland of boring, disposable content over the past three months. The older videos actually felt like someone cared. There were attractive, recognizable actresses, better chemistry, creative scenarios, and at least some attempt at an actual plot. Even when the stories were ridiculous, they had personality. You could see a thumbnail and genuinely think, “That looks worth watching.” Now it feels like the exact opposite. The recent uploads are painfully repetitive, unimaginative, and increasingly difficult to tell apart. The plots are either nonexistent or so lazy that calling them “plots” feels generous. Worse, the actresses frequently seem completely unknown and lacking the screen presence that made the older casts memorable. It’s hard to get excited about performers nobody recognizes when the casting itself already feels like an afterthought. The overall casting has become bizarrely uninspired. Instead of the appealing, charismatic performers that once made the site stand out, we’re getting casts that often feel completely mismatched with the audience the site originally attracted.
